test_modes.name: Compliance Pattern
test_modes.purpose: LTSSM Polling.Compliance sub-state transmits a defined compliance pattern for electrical characterization.

test_modes.name: Loopback
test_modes.purpose: Loopback Master transmits a known pattern; Loopback Slave retransmits it back. Used for receiver-eye testing.

test_modes.name: Hot Reset
test_modes.purpose: Triggers Link re-training via a TS1 with the Hot Reset bit set.

test_modes.name: Disable Link
test_modes.purpose: Force the Link into Electrical Idle for power / characterization.

spec_provided_observability.name: Lane Margining at the Receiver
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Gen5-mandatory in-system signal-integrity diagnostic: steps the receiver sampling point in time (left/right) and optionally voltage (up/down) while in L0 (no traffic interruption) and reports the error rate per lane.

spec_provided_observability.name: Equalization phase status
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Link Status 2 Register exposes the current EQ phase / de-emphasis; the Secondary PCIe Extended Capability holds per-lane Transmitter Preset + Receiver Preset Hint.

spec_provided_observability.name: LTSSM state probe
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Each Link's current LTSSM state (Detect / Polling / Configuration / L0 / L0s / L1 / L2 / Recovery / Disabled / Hot Reset / Loopback) is observable via Link Status Register + Link Capabilities Register + vendor-specific probe ports.

spec_provided_observability.name: TLP / DLLP capture
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Protocol analyzers tap into the Link via electrical interposers or via vendor-side mirrored ports.

spec_provided_observability.name: Retry Buffer monitor
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-Link retry-attempt counter (REPLAY_NUM) exposed as a status bit; retry-buffer occupancy is implementation-defined.

spec_provided_observability.name: Credit accounting
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-VC running credits for each of 6 credit types (PH/PD/NPH/NPD/CplH/CplD) — observable via VC Resource Status Register + UpdateFC traffic.

spec_provided_observability.name: 8b/10b symbol stream
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Lane-by-Lane symbol stream is the lowest-level observable; bit/symbol/Lane-decoding errors are reported via Receiver Error in Link Status + AER Uncorrectable Error Status.

spec_provided_observability.name: Lane skew status
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Multi-Lane elastic-buffer occupancy; SKP-set insertion + extraction rate is observable in the Physical Layer.

spec_provided_observability.name: Link Width + Speed
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Negotiated width and current speed observable in Link Status Register.

spec_provided_observability.name: Slot Status + Slot Capabilities
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Hot-plug event observability (Card Present, Power Indicator, Attention Indicator, MRL Sensor).

error_detection_mechanisms: 8b/10b decode errors — invalid 10-bit symbol or running-disparity violation; reported as Receiver Error.
TLP LCRC error (16-bit) — Data Link Layer triggers NAK + replay.
TLP ECRC error (32-bit, optional) — Transaction Layer logs in AER Uncorrectable Error Status.
Sequence Number error — TLP arriving out of expected sequence; receiver NAKs.
REPLAY_NUM rollover — repeated NAK / timeout; declares Link as failed → LTSSM Recovery / Detect.
Completion Timeout — Non-Posted Request did not get a Completion within the timeout window.
Unsupported Request (UR), Completer Abort (CA), Configuration Retry Status (CRS) — abnormal Completion Status codes.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: Card insertion / removal sensed by slot circuitry.
Per AER capability; e.g. Receiver Error, Bad TLP, Bad DLLP, REPLAY_NUM rollover.
Per AER capability; e.g. Poisoned TLP Received, Flow Control Protocol Error, Completion Timeout, Completer Abort.
RC aggregates First / Next Uncorrectable Error sources via Root Error Status.
Endpoint generates PM_PME Message; routed up to RC.

notes: PCI Express 5.0 adds Lane Margining at the Receiver as a mandatory protocol-level observability feature plus the per-lane equalization preset registers needed for the four-phase enhanced EQ. The in-band error framework (CRC + Sequence Number + replay + AER) is carried forward from base PCIe. JTAG / scan / BIST remain integrator-side at the SoC.
